description: Close an open Premiere Pro project: the active one, or the open project at project_path. Verifies it is no longer open and reports which project is active afterwards.

project_path.description: Path of the open project to close (default: the active project)

save_first.description: Whether to save before closing (default: true)

name: close_project

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Close Project
